title: fix(models): Claude CLI models stay Sign-in needed after signing in until a Gateway restart
body:
Closes #196694
Related: #186358
Closes #191831

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Claude CLI models stay "Sign-in needed" in `/models` and the Discord model picker, and `/model` rejects them, after you sign in to Claude Code, if the Gateway started while Claude Code was not signed in (or its first login check failed). Real turns through `claude-cli` worked, but these chat surfaces did not recover until a Gateway restart. The Control UI recovered or not depending on timing.

## User Impact

User impact: signing in to Claude Code on the Gateway host now shows the Claude CLI models as available, and lets `/model` and the Discord picker select them, without restarting the Gateway. The first model list read after sign-in may still show the old state; the next read (or a direct `/model`) uses the new login.

## Why This Change Was Made

- The Gateway records Claude Code's login once at startup and is designed to recheck it after a minute while model lists are read (#166305, #172471). That background recheck was started inside the plugin invocation scope of the request that triggered it. The `claude auth status` probe finishes after that request has replied and closed its scope, so publishing the result threw `Plugin invocation scope is closed`. The error was swallowed, so the stale "signed out" state stayed until restart. The recheck now runs in a detached async context (the same pattern the prepared-model-runtime refresh uses), and an unexpected failure is logged instead of hidden.
- Only Gateway `models.list` (the Control UI) triggered that recheck. `/models`, the `/model` menu and the Discord picker read the same prepared data and never triggered it, so channel-only users could not recover even with a working recheck. They now trigger the same throttled recheck. `/model` selection awaits it, so a direct `/model anthropic/...` after sign-in works on the first try.
- On main, recovery through the Control UI depended on timing: a `models.list` recheck published only if the probe finished before that request closed its scope. In my `models.list`-only base run it won that race and recovered. The failure shows up reliably when `/models` or `/model` triggers the recheck.
- The probe cost limit is unchanged: at most one `claude auth status` per prepared catalog owner per minute, and only while pickers or selections are read.

Not changed: #196694 also suggests passing config into `resolveCliRuntimeModelBackendBinding`. On real Gateways the CLI backend binding was always present (instrumented `binding={"provider":"anthropic","runtime":"claude-cli"}` on every evaluation, including hot plugin enable and `plugins.allow` edits). That issue's failure is the same stale login state shown below, and it went away for the reporter after the Gateway restart. This PR leaves that binding call alone.

## Evidence

Isolated Gateways (`env -i`, own state/config/profile/port), real Claude Code 2.1.322 with its real login. A PATH shim answers only `claude auth status` with `loggedIn:false` until a flag file is removed. Removing the flag stands in for `claude auth login`. Every other Claude call, including inference, goes to the real CLI. Commands go through Gateway `chat.send` (the auto-reply owner that channel commands use) and Gateway `models.list` (the Control UI picker data).

| Step, after Claude Code sign-in (75 s+ wait) | origin/main `63db5996` | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/models anthropic` (1st read) | `Sign-in needed — Claude CLI · Claude Opus 5.5` | same (this read starts the recheck) |
| `/models anthropic` (2nd read) | still `Sign-in needed`, again after 3+ min | `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 (Claude CLI · Claude Opus 5.5)` |
| `/model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5` | `A runtime is not available for anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5: sign-in needed…` | `Model set to anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 … Runtime set to claude-cli` |
| direct `/model anthropic/claude-opus-5-5` (no list read first) | (same failure as above) | `Model set … Runtime set to claude-cli` on the first try |
| Gateway `models.list` (Control UI picker data), `models.list`-only run | recovered to `available:true` about 2 min after sign-in (its recheck finished while the request was open) | `available:true` from the second read on |
| Gateway `models.list` after the `/models` and `/model` reads above | still `missing-auth` (the recheck failed with the error below) | `available:true` |
| real turn on the selected session | n/a (selection rejected) | `CC10-AFTER-OK` / `CC10-DIRECT-OK` via `[agent/cli-backend] cli turn: provider=claude-cli` |
| Gateway log on recheck | `Error: Plugin invocation scope is closed` at `prepareModelCatalogThinkingPolicies` (instrumented; swallowed in production) | none |

Base instrumentation also showed the recheck probe returning `status:"available"` and computing `{"claude-cli":{"source":"native","mode":"oauth"}}`, then failing to publish. Readers kept `authModes: {}`.

Tests (red on base, green here):
- `src/agents/prepared-model-runtime.native-login.test.ts`: a recheck whose plugin work finishes after the triggering read's invocation scope closes still publishes the login.
- `src/auto-reply/reply/commands-models.catalog-recovery.test.ts`: `/models` and the Discord picker data (`getModelsRuntimeChoices`) recheck a later sign-in. Before the recheck the picker gets `undefined` choices, which is the "Could not confirm how to run this model" state with Submit disabled. After it, the choices include `claude-cli`.
- `src/agents/model-runtime-choice.test.ts`: `preparePublishedModelRuntimeChoice` (`/model`, session model selection) rechecks before deciding.

Also ran 92 suites covering prepared-model-runtime, model-runtime-choice, `/models` commands, directive handling, gateway `models.*` methods, plugin-sdk model surfaces and the Discord model picker: all passed. `node scripts/check-changed.mjs`: format, line-cap, boundary, typecheck and changed-file guards passed. Two steps failed: `lint core` and the dead-export scan. Both report only files this PR does not touch. Running `oxlint` on the 6 changed files reports 0 warnings and 0 errors. The same `lint core` shard also exits 1 on an unmodified origin/main worktree at `63db5996`.

Gaps: #186358 also reports that the Control UI composer's credential banner ignores the selected runtime choice. This PR does not change that check, so that issue stays open. Discord component clicks need a human Discord client, so I did not click through the picker. The picker's data owner (`buildPreparedModelsProviderData`) and its `getModelsRuntimeChoices` result are covered above. Control UI proof is the Gateway `models.list` response the picker renders. This is not a visual change.

Production +21/-2, tests +74 net, docs +3/-2.
